bio: Done out entirely in warm wood, the dining room oozes charm. In this cosy setting, heavy rustic chairs surround natural wooden tables, with beautiful old panelling adorning the ceiling and walls. In keeping with the traditional feel of the place, the cuisine is hearty and regional. Delicate lamb ragout served with wonderfully creamy bramata features on the menu alongside Güggeli (chicken) and cordon bleu. Tip: Dishes for sharing are also available. The welcoming atmosphere is enhanced by the friendly service – the chef personally greets every diner with a handshake.
